problems.problem: Prove that the infinite geometric sequence $\{2^k\}_{k=0}^{\infty}$ does not contain a three-term arithmetic progression.
Let $n$ be odd. Compute the determinant of an $n\times n$ skew-symmetric matrix $A=(a_{ij})$, where $a_{ii}=0$ and $a_{ji}=-a_{ij}$ for $i<j$.
Let $[x]$ denote the integer part of $x$. Find $\displaystyle\lim_{n\to\infty}\left((\sqrt3+1)^n-[(\sqrt3+1)^n]\right)$.
Suppose that $f$ is an even, twice continuously differentiable function and $f''(0)\ne0$. Prove that $f$ has an extremum at $x=0$.
